description.value: Black's Pub is a warm, lively pub and restaurant at the base of Whistler Mountain in the heart of Whistler Village, part of the Gibbons Whistler hospitality group. It serves breakfast through to late evening, with a full all-day food menu alongside local craft beers, curated wines, and creative cocktails. A patio with panoramic mountain views and weekly events like Bandaoke (live-band karaoke) make it a hub for both outdoor adventurers and the local community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at gibbonswhistler.com/venue/blacks-pub/ provides rich content confirming Black's Pub is an active, full-service pub and restaurant at the base of Whistler Mountain, open daily with a patio and mountain views. The website lists a different address (7-4340 Sundial Place, V8E 1G5) than the OSM record (4270 Mountain Square, V0N 1B4), which is flagged as a concern. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records '4270 Mountain Square, V0N 1B4' but the business website lists '7-4340 Sundial Place, Whistler, BC V8E 1G5'. The website address has been used in this record and the discrepancy should be verified.
OSM has no phone number; website provides 604-932-6408 (local) and 1-888-823-7932 (toll-free for Gibbons group head office). Local number used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Black's Pub is a legitimate, active food and drink venue in Whistler Village that would serve touring cyclists well, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website content. Additionally, the OSM address does not match the website address, which should be resolved before listing.
